paragraphs: Jirayu Construction Materials (Reg. 0553555000034) is a registered general contractor established 9 January 2012, located at 36 Moo 10, Kong Khwai, Mueang Nan. We provide home building, general construction, civil engineering, design, drafting, and plan certification in Mueang Nan, Chiang Klang, Tha Wang Pha, Pua, and Wiang Sa.

We also supply construction materials and surveying services for government, commercial, office, and residential projects within our 5 service districts only — we do not accept work outside these areas.
If you are in Mueang Nan, Chiang Klang, Tha Wang Pha, Pua, or Wiang Sa and need a registered contractor with long experience, Jirayu Construction Materials offers free consultation and site surveys.

items.question: What is the starting price for construction in Nan Province?
items.answer: Construction costs in Nan Province depend on project size, scope, materials, and design complexity. We provide a free initial estimate after a site survey so you receive a clear, transparent quotation before work begins.

items.question: How do I choose a reliable contractor in Nan Province?
items.answer: Look for proven experience, a strong portfolio, transparent pricing, a clear contract, and after-sales support. Jirayu Construction has over 10 years serving Nan Province with professional teams and progress tracking throughout every project.

items.question: How long does it take to build a home in Nan Province?
items.answer: Timeline depends on size and complexity. A single-storey home typically takes 4–8 months; a two-storey home may take 8–14 months. We provide a clear schedule in the contract after site survey and design.

items.question: What is the starting price for home construction in Nan?
items.answer: Pricing depends on area, materials, and design. We offer a free initial estimate after understanding your requirements and build site.

items.question: Do you offer architectural design and interior services?
items.answer: Yes — from architectural design and 3D visuals to construction and interior finishing. You can choose full-service or individual packages.

items.question: Which areas do you serve?
items.answer: We serve 5 districts only: Mueang Nan, Chiang Klang, Tha Wang Pha, Pua, and Wiang Sa. We do not accept projects outside these areas.
